mostWorthwhile.text: Following fat into intestinal cells, packaging it as chylomicrons and sending it into lymph made its different route from glucose and amino acids clear. The planned pictures and prose identify the particles and explain that lymph carries them onward to blood.

leastWorthwhile.text: The parallel glucose and amino-acid absorption results were clear but sparse: neither planned picture explains the transport mechanisms across the intestinal cells.

surprise.text: The villus was required as a station both for packaging fat and for entry into the lacteal; compatibility feedback automatically completed each operation.

arbitrary.text: Combining the two blood-borne nutrients to create portal blood felt like a gameplay convenience: each can travel in blood independently, and the connection to the liver was not built here.

continue.text: I would continue to see how absorbed nutrients are used after reaching the liver; the contrasting routes made that next connection interesting, even though some transport details were abbreviated.
